items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember George Bocquet when you were young, hearing him? [INTERVIEWEE] I remember Charlie Bocquet. Do you know him?

ctx.x: Well, yeah, later Johnny Dodd did play a couple of funerals, I do remember that.
Do you remember George Bocquet when you were young, hearing him?
I remember Charlie Bocquet. Do you know him?
